summary: As of 2026-10-01, the verdict is NO_ADVERSE at 80% confidence. The decisive facts are: the exact legal name is In-N-Out Burger, Inc. (confirmed 2019-02-25); the chain was founded in 1948, headquartered in Irvine, California, and is currently owned and controlled by Lynsi Snyder (confirmed 2026-08-03); and searches covering 2020-01-01 through 2026-09-30 revealed no criminal convictions, bankruptcies, insolvency proceedings, regulator enforcement actions exceeding $1 million, or civil judgments exceeding $5 million.

findings.statement: The exact legal name of the company that operates the In-N-Out Burger restaurant chain is In-N-Out Burger, Inc.
In-N-Out Burger was founded in 1948 by Harry and Esther Snyder, is headquartered in Irvine, California, and is currently owned and controlled by Lynsi Snyder.

Searches for criminal indictments, convictions, bankruptcy, regulator enforcement actions, and civil judgments exceeding $5 million between 2020-01-01 and 2026-09-30 returned no material adverse findings for In-N-Out Burger.
